title: Wonderful
text: Jon was a fantastic guide. My son is very knowledgeable of the Spanish Civil War, and Jon happily engaged in discussions about it. Plus, the views are amazing.
author: torye2019

title: Mount Tobidabo tour
text: We went up to the Mountain. Our driver and guide were very courteous and on time, picking us up right at the hotel. We were taken to an old view point in Barcelona and he explained the history of the area and uses today. The beautiful views showed both sides of Barcelona (residential as well as commercial/tourist). Then we traveled to the Mountain. We saw the beautiful church and climbed to the top for remarkable views of Barcelona. Great experience. Would highly recommend this experience.
author: Mary_R
